#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <memory>
struct JSFunction;
// The finite context owns its fake GC heap. RootedFunction below is only a
// borrowed root, exactly as in the emitted function; it must not delete it.
struct JSContext {
 bool exception = false;
 std::unique_ptr<JSFunction> functions[16];
};
struct JSObject {};
struct PromiseCombinatorDataHolder : JSObject {};
struct Value { int tag=0; int data=0; bool isObject() const { return tag==1; } };
template<class T> struct Handle;
template<> struct Handle<Value> { Value value; bool isObject() const { return value.isObject(); } operator Value() const { return value; } };
template<> struct Handle<PromiseCombinatorDataHolder*> { PromiseCombinatorDataHolder* value; PromiseCombinatorDataHolder& operator*() const { return *value; } };
struct JSFunction : JSObject { Value slot[2]; void setExtendedSlot(int i, Value v) { slot[i]=v; } };
struct RootedFunction { JSFunction* value; RootedFunction(JSContext*,JSFunction* v):value(v) {} operator bool() const {return value!=nullptr;} operator JSFunction*() const {return value;} JSFunction* operator->() const {return value;} JSFunction* get() const {return value;} };
using Native = int;
namespace gc { enum class AllocKind { FUNCTION_EXTENDED }; }
constexpr int GenericObject=0;
constexpr int PromiseCombinatorElementFunctionSlot_ElementIndexOrResolveFunc=0;
constexpr int PromiseCombinatorElementFunctionSlot_Data=1;
Value NullValue(){return {2,0};} Value Int32Value(uint32_t x){return {3,static_cast<int>(x)};} Value ObjectValue(PromiseCombinatorDataHolder&){return {1,17};}
struct Hooks { bool (*beforeCapturedAllocate)(JSContext*,void**); void (*allocationFailed)(void*); void (*capturedCreated)(JSContext*,JSObject*,void*); };
static JSContext* activationPromiseContext=nullptr; static Hooks* activationPromiseHooks=nullptr;
static int limit=0, admitted=0, created=0, failed=0, allocs=0; static bool fail_native=false; static int owner[16];
bool before(JSContext* cx,void** out){if(admitted>=limit){cx->exception=true;return false;} *out=&owner[admitted++];return true;}
void failed_alloc(void*){++failed;} void created_obj(JSContext*,JSObject*,void*){++created;}
JSFunction* NewNativeFunction(JSContext* cx, Native, int, std::nullptr_t, gc::AllocKind, int){
 if(fail_native || allocs==16){cx->exception=true;return nullptr;}
 auto& function=cx->functions[allocs];
 function=std::make_unique<JSFunction>();
 ++allocs;
 return function.get();
}
/* LSF_COMBINATOR_TARGET */

int main(int argc,char** argv){
 if(argc!=2)return 2;
 static JSContext cx; static Hooks hooks{before,failed_alloc,created_obj}; activationPromiseContext=&cx;
 PromiseCombinatorDataHolder holder; Handle<PromiseCombinatorDataHolder*> data{&holder}; Handle<Value> ordinary{{0,0}};
 bool ok=false;
 if(!std::strcmp(argv[1],"selected-limit")){
  activationPromiseHooks=&hooks;limit=2;
  auto* a=NewPromiseCombinatorElementFunction(&cx,0,data,0,ordinary);
  auto* b=NewPromiseCombinatorElementFunction(&cx,0,data,1,ordinary);
  auto* c=NewPromiseCombinatorElementFunction(&cx,0,data,2,ordinary);
  ok=a&&b&&!c&&cx.exception&&admitted==2&&created==2&&allocs==2;
 }else if(!std::strcmp(argv[1],"unselected-original")){
  activationPromiseHooks=nullptr;limit=0; auto* a=NewPromiseCombinatorElementFunction(&cx,0,data,7,ordinary);
  ok=a&&admitted==0&&created==0&&allocs==1&&a->slot[0].tag==3&&a->slot[0].data==7&&a->slot[1].tag==1;
 }else if(!std::strcmp(argv[1],"allocation-failure")){
  activationPromiseHooks=&hooks;limit=1;fail_native=true;
  auto* a=NewPromiseCombinatorElementFunction(&cx,0,data,0,ordinary);
  ok=!a&&cx.exception&&admitted==1&&failed==1&&created==0&&allocs==0;
 }else if(!std::strcmp(argv[1],"paired-slots")){
  activationPromiseHooks=&hooks;limit=1;Handle<Value> prior{{1,44}};
  auto* a=NewPromiseCombinatorElementFunction(&cx,0,data,7,prior);
  ok=a&&a->slot[0].tag==1&&a->slot[0].data==44&&a->slot[1].tag==2&&admitted==1&&created==1;
 }else if(!std::strcmp(argv[1],"paired-refusal")){
  activationPromiseHooks=&hooks;limit=1;Handle<Value> prior{{1,44}};
  auto* a=NewPromiseCombinatorElementFunction(&cx,0,data,7,ordinary);
  auto* b=NewPromiseCombinatorElementFunction(&cx,0,data,7,prior);
  ok=a&&!b&&cx.exception&&admitted==1&&created==1&&allocs==1&&a->slot[0].data==7;
 } else return 2;
 // Destroy the fake GC objects on negative controls as well as positive ones.
 // This is harness cleanup, not a collector or production retirement witness.
 for(auto& function:cx.functions) function.reset();
 std::printf("{\"case\":\"%s\",\"passed\":%s,\"admitted\":%d,\"created\":%d,\"allocations\":%d,\"engineQualified\":false}\n",argv[1],ok?"true":"false",admitted,created,allocs);
 return ok?0:1;
}
